brief_summary: A multi-center, randomized, double-blind, phase III clinical trial to evaluate the efficacy and safety of Olmesartan/Amlodipine/Rosuvastatin combination treatment in patients with concomitant hypertension and hyperlipidemia
brief_title: A Clinical Trial to Evaluate the Efficacy and Safety of Olmesartan/Amlodipine/Rosuvastatin Combination Treatment in Patients With Concomitant Hypertension and Hyperlipidemia

eligibility.criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Age 20 to 80 years
* patients with hypertension and hyperlipidemias

Exclusion Criteria:

* orthostatic hypotension
* History of ventricular tachycardia, atrial fibrillation
* uncontrolled diabetes mellitus

official_title: A Multi-center, Randomized, Double-blind, Phase III Clinical Trial to Evaluate the Efficacy and Safety of Olmesartan/Amlodipine/Rosuvastatin Combination Treatment in Patients With Concomitant Hypertension and Hyperlipidemia
